blocks.text: Michael V. will serve as the special guest host of “Family Feud,” temporarily replacing regular host Dingdong Dantes who will be taking a break from his hosting duties. Dantes announced this during the reality game show’s episode on Wednesday, Sept. 16. “Dahil po sa walang sawa niyong pagtangkilik sa ‘The Master Cutter,’ at dahil kailangan kong tutukan ang mga paparating na taping ng programa para lalo pa itong mapaganda, pansamantala po akong magpapahinga bilang host ng ‘Family Feud,'” he said, referring to his ongoing GMA TV series. “Pero ‘wag po kayong mag-alala dahil tuluy-tuloy pa rin po ang more tawa at […]...
